senses.gloss: f. (ארע; corresp. to h. צִרְעָה) wasp, hornet (collect.).
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 23:28">Targ. Y. Ex. XXIII, 28</cite>; a. e.—Pl. <he>אוּרְעַיָּיתָא</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 1:44">Targ. Y. Deut. I, 44</cite>; a. e.—<cite ref="A00910"><he>אוּרְעֵי</he></cite>, <he>אוּרְעַיָּה</he>.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 11:20">Targ. Y. Lev. XI, 20</cite> ed. pr. (corr. vowel signs; later ed. <cite ref="A00610"><he>אוזפיה</he></cite>). Y. Sabb. I, 3ᵇ bot. <he>תולעתא דסוסיא וכ׳</he> the mite in the horse’s carcass turns into hornets. [Cmp. same ideas among the Greek, Sachs Beitr. II, 92; Nican Ther. 741.]
